    Args:
        exc: The exception to render.
        exception_data: The HTML exception data to render.
        error: The error title to render.
        error_description: The error description to render.

        The HTML response content.

    traceback_text = "".join(traceback.format_exception(type(exc), exc, exc.__traceback__))

        Path(__file__).parent / "templates" / "body.html",

        Path(__file__).parent / "templates" / "scripts.js",

        Path(__file__).parent / "templates" / "styles.css",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as styles_file:
